data.name: gestaltview-gen-render-engine
data.description: Inspect, implement, repair, and verify the GestaltView semantic-source-to-artifact pipeline using the live nextgen.scene-graph.v1 contract, durable Supabase job/artifact receipts, private storage, owner-scoped retrieval, per-target failure isolation, presentation repair, and explicit idempotent Gallery projection. Capability claims must be labeled verified, partial, planned, or unsupported.
data.whenToUse: Use when GestaltView artifacts show raw Markdown/JSON/path strings, repetition failures, request/schema/status drift, empty render ledgers, failed persistence or retrieval, backend fan-out failures, phantom async jobs, or Gallery projection gaps; also use when adding a target or source adapter and proving it end to end.
